commentary.text: 90+5' That's it for today, Tobias Reichel has blown his whistle and the game is over.
90+2' Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) seems to have forgotten that he has already received a yellow card as he is surprised when the referee shows him a second one!
90' The fourth official shows 3 min. of added time.
90' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is shown the yellow card for talking out of turn to the referee. It could have been worse!
90' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) commits a foul and Tobias Reichel immediately signals a free kick.
89' Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli) picks up a yellow card.
88' It's time for a substitution. That's the last involvement from Morgan Guilavogui as he is replaced by Johannes Eggestein (St. Pauli).
88' Alexander Blessin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Lars Ritzka (St. Pauli) replacing Siebe Van Der Heyden.
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marvin Ducksch trots off the pitch and is replaced by Marco Grull (Werder Bremen).
82' Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen) is booked by the referee.
81' Substitution. Felix Agu walks off the pitch and Derrick Kohn (Werder Bremen) comes on as a substitute.
81' Here is a change. Senne Lynen is going off and Ole Werner gives the last tactical orders to Leonardo Bittencourt (Werder Bremen).
81' The goal by Werder Bremen won’t count as referee Tobias Reichel disallows the goal on the advice of the video assistant referee.
81' Possible change! There could be offside in the lead up. Referee Tobias Reichel wants to look at it, so he’s going to review using VAR.
80' Here comes the VAR verdict. NO GOAL for Werder Bremen due to an offside in the build-up play.
80' Goal! Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) latches on to an accurate pass and quickly strikes a low effort inside the right post.
75' Alexander Blessin prepares a substitution. Carlo Boukhalfa is replaced by Robert Wagner (St. Pauli).
75' Substitution. Danel Sinani is replaced by Connor Metcalfe (St. Pauli).
74' Poor challenge! Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is penalised for tripping and Tobias Reichel blows his whistle.
71' Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
69' Ole Werner has decided to substitute Justin Njinmah and he is replaced by Oliver Burke (Werder Bremen).
66' Elias Saad (St. Pauli) tries to send a pass but it's blocked.
63' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
62' Substitution. Noah Weisshaupt makes way for Elias Saad (St. Pauli).
58' Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) tricks his way to edge of the area and unleashes a howitzer of a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Nikola Vasilj earns his money with a fine reflex save.
54' Siebe Van Der Heyden (St. Pauli) commits a rough foul. Tobias Reichel stops the game and makes a call.
50' A corner kick by Werder Bremen is thwarted by the well prepared Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli).

49' Niklas Stark (Werder Bremen) latches onto a precise lofted pass into the penalty area and produces a header at goal, but his attempt to the right side of the goal fails to beat Nikola Vasilj, who makes a sensational save. Now Werder Bremen have a corner.
49' Manolis Saliakas (St. Pauli) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Tobias Reichel has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
46' The second half has just started.
45+3' Tobias Reichel has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+1' St. Pauli failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
44' St. Pauli are dominating the game at the moment by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. Great harmony between the players.
43' Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli) runs onto a pass and from the edge of the box tries his luck with a dipping shot. Unfortunately for him, the effort fizzes just over the bar.
40' The resulting set piece from St. Pauli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

39' Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) finds himself free inside the box and pulls the trigger, but his effort is brilliantly stopped by one of the defending players. Corner kick. St. Pauli will have an opportunity.
38' A goal, which was scored by Jens Stage (Werder Bremen), was disallowed due to offside.
35' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) plays a through ball but overhits it.
31' The game is interrupted now, Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
30' Looks like Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
30' Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
25' One of the players from Werder Bremen times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
25' Morgan Guilavogui (St. Pauli) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Tobias Reichel no option but to blow his whistle.
19' A player from Werder Bremen commits a rough challenge. Tobias Reichel blows for a foul and keeps the game under control.
13' Danel Sinani (St. Pauli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
12' Werder Bremen keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
10' Carlo Boukhalfa (St. Pauli) has a goal ruled out for offside!
7' Nikola Vasilj (St. Pauli) puts a cross into the box from the corner but there is no panic from the opposition and they easily clear.
5' Marvin Ducksch (Werder Bremen) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
3' Mitchell Weiser (Werder Bremen) hits a screaming first-time shot from the edge of the box from a clearance, but it flies a whisker wide of the left post.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Werder Bremen will kick-off.
